description: Practice Range: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Five target drones are set out for gunnery. Three sit still and two move. Press T to lock the nearest, aim at the red diamond and fire with Space or left click. The keys 1 to 4 move power between engines, shields and weapons.
success: All five drones are down. That is the gunnery done.
failure: The drones are still flying. We will reset the range.
radio-still: Pell: Three drones ahead, not moving. T locks the nearest. Space or left click fires. Press 3 to send power to your weapons.
Pell: Targets in front of you. T picks the nearest one. Put your nose on it and hold Space.
radio-moving: Pell: Two more, and these ones move. Aim at the red diamond, not at the drone. It shows where your shots will meet it. Press 4 to balance your power again.
Pell: Moving targets now. T locks, then put your nose on the red diamond and fire. If you keep missing, you are aiming at the drone.
